workload: 2,520 mathematical text and diagram-node labels; 2,400 fully offscreen, 120 visible. Grid and axes off.
provenance: Actual isolated headless Chromium, controlled scene imported into each full application, 4 warmups and 12 measured SVG rebuilds per version. Same browser executable and viewport. Does not measure UI event latency, JSON import, GPU frame budget, font parity, or cross-device performance.
limitations: Results are scene-dependent, no 60 FPS certification
No promise for mostly on-screen text or dense curved diagrams
Browser text size is estimated conservatively for safe culling
Full project data including offscreen labels is never removed
